CIRCULAR_TRANSACTION.description: Identity theft and cheating by personation using computer resources. Circular transactions may involve use of stolen credentials or identity to operate accounts.
Money laundering offence. Circular fund movement is a classic layering technique under PMLA.

TRANSACTION_CHAIN.description: Layering of proceeds of crime through multi-hop transfers.
Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) trigger: structured transfers designed to layer funds.

SIM_SWAP_CHAIN.description: Identity theft — use of stolen SIM or credentials to access banking accounts.
Cheating and dishonestly inducing delivery of property.
Telecom Regulatory Authority of India guidelines on SIM swap fraud reporting.

SHARED_INFRASTRUCTURE.description: Conspiracy to launder money using shared devices/infrastructure.

RAPID_FUND_MOVEMENT.description: Rapid sequential transfers are a known SAR trigger for structuring/layering.

TEMPORAL_ANOMALY.description: Unauthorised access to computer systems evidenced by anomalous timing.
